parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The hash value of the backup point
parameters.name: snapshot_hash

parameters.help_en: The hash value of the directory. If you do not specify this parameter, the root directory of the backup is browsed
parameters.help_zh: 目录的哈希值，不指定表示浏览备份的根目录
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The path of the directory. Use a forward slash (/) to browse the root directory of the backup
parameters.help_zh: 目录的路径，浏览备份根目录时使用 /
parameters.name: absolute_path

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，建议改用MaxResults和NextToken参数实现翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，建议改用MaxResults和NextToken参数实现翻页
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The token required to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 获取下一页结果所需的Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries returned per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The storage class of the backup data. Valid values:
STANDARD: Standard.
ARCHIVE: Archive
parameters.help_zh:
备份数据存储类型。取值：
STANDARD：标准。
ARCHIVE：归档
parameters.name: storage_class

parameters.help_en:
The edition of Cloud Backup. Valid values:
STANDARD: Standard Edition. This is the default value.
BASIC: Basic Edition. Only ECS File Backup Essential Edition is supported
parameters.help_zh:
云备份功能版本，支持：
STANDARD: 标准版，默认值。
BASIC：基础版。目前仅支持ECS文件备份基础版
parameters.name: edition

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of data records returned in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request is successful, successful is returned. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. If NextToken is empty, no more pages are available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页开始的Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一页

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful.

true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
